title: STAG-Net: Structure-Aware Attention over Landmark Groups for Lightweight Head Pose Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Head pose estimation is important for human computer interaction and driver monitoring, but many image based methods remain too costly for resource constrained deployment. We propose STAG-Net, a structure-aware attention over landmark groups for lightweight head Pose estimation that estimates head pose from facial landmarks using movement aware selection, spatial clustering, compact DeepSet encoders, self attention, and a global geometry descriptor. We develop variants using FaceMesh and Face Alignment Network landmarks and evaluate them under cross dataset and subject independent protocols on 300W-LP, AFLW2000, and BIWI. STAG-Net achieves the lowest mean absolute error among all compared landmark based methods in every evaluated setting. translated_title: STAG-Net：基于地标组的结构感知注意力机制实现轻量级头部姿态估计
translated_abstract: 头部姿态估计对人机交互和驾驶员监控非常重要，但许多基于图像的方法对于资源受限的部署场景而言计算成本仍然过高。我们提出了STAG-Net，一种面向轻量级头部姿态估计的基于地标组的结构感知注意力方法，它通过运动感知选择、空间聚类、紧凑的DeepSet编码器、自注意力机制以及全局几何描述子，从面部关键点估计头部姿态。我们开发了使用FaceMesh和面部对齐网络（FAN）关键点的两种变体，并在300W-LP、AFLW2000和BIWI数据集上，采用跨数据集和独立于受试者的评估协议进行了测试。在所有评估设置中，STAG-Net在所有被比较的基于关键点的方法中均取得了最低的平均绝对误差。在具有有效检测结果的BIWI帧上，FAN变体还在所有被比较的方法中录得最低的总体误差，在跨数据集评估下达到3.51°，在独立于受试者的评估下达到2.39°。
tldr: STAG-Net通过对面部关键点组施加结构感知注意力（结合运动感知选择、空间聚类、紧凑DeepSet编码器和全局几何描述子），以极低的计算成本实现了精度领先的轻量级头部姿态估计。
en_tdlr: STAG-Net achieves lightweight yet state-of-the-art head pose estimation by applying structure-aware attention over facial landmark groups using movement-aware selection, spatial clustering, and compact DeepSet encoders.
